product.title: Yankee Sitcom Hat (Pinstripe)
product.description: A collectible baseball cap inspired by the iconic Seinfeld sitcom, available in multiple styles and colors for fans of pop culture and retro fashion.

dossier.headline: Yankee Sitcom Hat, Pinstripe Snapback
dossier.summary: The Yankee Sitcom Hat is a collectible snapback baseball cap by Hat Trick NYC, a Brooklyn-based brand founded by Erik and Bronson that fuses 1990s baseball culture with classic sitcom nostalgia. It is an unstructured, one-size-fits-most snapback priced at $39.99, sold across several colorways in the brand's Seinfeld-inspired sitcom line.

facts.label: Material
facts.value: High-quality cotton or canvas (varies by colorway)

story.title: Born From Seinfeld and Baseball
story.detail: Hat Trick NYC's founders, Erik and Bronson, state they both love watching Seinfeld and baseball and thought the two paired nicely, so they made a hat. The brand frames its products as a natural pairing of those two cultural touchstones.

story.title: 90s Sports Nostalgia
story.detail: Hat Trick NYC positions its caps as a revival of '90s sports nostalgia, explicitly tying them to Major League Baseball imagery and classic sitcom television, chiefly Seinfeld. The Yankees Season 8 variant references the 1996 World Series win and the show's eighth season (1996–97).

story.title: A Growing Sitcom Collection
story.detail: The Yankee Sitcom Hat sits within a broader sitcom collection that Hat Trick NYC has expanded to include the Mets Sitcom Hat and the Mariner Sitcom Hat, applying the same retro-baseball concept across teams.

references.title: Yankees Seinfeld Hat
references.detail: Hat Trick NYC describes the Yankee Sitcom Hat as 'a fusion of two beloved pop culture icons,' calling it the Yankees Seinfeld hat.

references.title: 1996–97 Checkerboard Logo
references.detail: The Season 8 variant is described as inspired by the iconic checkerboard logo from the 1996–97 season.

references.title: Dad-Hat Silhouette
references.detail: The unstructured crown is marketed as 'an updated version of your dad's favorite hat in the 90's,' with a relaxed fit.

dossier.pairingImagePrompt: A single neatly aligned top-down knolling flat-lay on a seamless neutral background, editorial lighting: the HAT TRICK NYC Yankee Sitcom Hat in pinstripe placed alongside a pair of Levi's 501 Original jeans, a pair of white Adidas Samba sneakers, a plain white Hanes Beefy-T, and a navy Alpha Industries MA-1 bomber jacket. Use a true top-down flat-lay for all items. Every object whole and intact with parts connected, in its natural orientation, in correct scale relative to the others, evenly spaced on a grid with no overlaps.

dossier.lookbookStyle: Sunlit editorial photography with warm natural light, slightly nostalgic film-stock grain, clean urban Brooklyn backdrops, relaxed 90s sportswear mood.
dossier.lookbookPrompt: A single editorial lookbook sheet in one 3:2 landscape image, arranged as a strict 2x2 grid (2 rows x 2 columns) of four landscape photographs with uniform hairline gutters, grid flush to all four edges with no outer margin or border, all cells identical in size. Cell 1 (top-left): close crop of the HAT TRICK NYC Yankee Sitcom Hat in pinstripe worn on a person's head, three-quarter angle. Cell 2 (top-right): full styled look of the cap with a white tee and Levi's 501 jeans against a brick wall. Cell 3 (bottom-left): the cap paired with a navy bomber jacket, side profile portrait. Cell 4 (bottom-right): overhead detail of the pinstripe cap resting on a bench beside white Adidas Samba sneakers. In each cell frame the subject to fill about two thirds of the cell. Vary pose, crop, angle and setting between cells; every frame shares warm sunlit natural light with subtle film grain and a nostalgic 90s sportswear mood. No text, captions, numbers, watermarks, rounded corners or drop shadows.
